{{Quote|Can't say I'm too surprised that you turned out to be a Jedi. I'm staying.|Shaylai Veila|<ref name="Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4">[[Dark Times—A Spark Remains 4|''Dark Times—A Spark Remains'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Shaylai Veila''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] that served as a secretary to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kai Hudorra]] following his acquisition of [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] on [[Kestavel]].

==Biography==
When [[Dass Jennir]], [[Beyghor Sahdett]], and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' arrived at the casino in search of Hudorra, Veila walked in with an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] ahead of the main group. She later opened the door to Hudorra's office, and was told not to let anyone disturb their private meeting.

After Sahdett's [[Duel on Kestavel|betrayal]], Veila helped clean up the bodies and debris. When Hudorra tried to force his remaining staff to flee in advance of the upcoming [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack, Veila, along with [[Bryti]], [[Kal (bodyguard)|Kal]], [[Dayn]], and [[Nira]], reaffirmed their loyalty to the Jedi Master, refusing to abandon him. She and Kal later helped seal the casino entranceway with [[Concrete/Legends|concrete]]. The Twi'lek sat at Hudorra's right side during a final feast, where the Bothan told everyone that only he and Jennir would be staying.

Later, as Vader and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] marched across the bridge to the casino, Veila was already aboard the ''Uhumele'' and watched Kal catch the ziplining Greenbark, the last crewmember to evacuate. She noted that they better inside quickly, before the [[fog creature]]s discovered them. Veila would later be witness to Hudorra's final message, recorded on a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] given to Jennir by Bryti, wishing that [[May the Force be with you/Legends|the Force be with her]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek is referred to by Hudorra twice, first as "Veila", then as "Shaylai". Which name is her first and last is conjectural; this article uses Veila as the latter as it is a known [[Veila family|surname]] in-universe.
